overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation: the meeting was noticed and held in person at an accessible location, with live broadcast as an added means of access, so remote audio gaps during a recess did not violate the law.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged that during a muted recess at the Nov. 14, 2022 meeting, remote viewers could not hear members' discussions with members of the public.
